status: phase-1: structure and copy approved; numeric specifications awaiting factory confirmation

specFields.label: Model / SKU
specFields.needed: Assign once the tool route is fixed
specFields.note: An existing tool already has a model code. A new tool is coded after T1 approval.

specFields.label: Material
specFields.needed: Resin grade named on the drawing
specFields.note: PP, PS, AS and Tritan are all molded in house. The grade is stated per project, not per page.

specFields.label: Fill capacity
specFields.note: Capacity comes from the cavity, so it is confirmed with the tool, not before it.

specFields.label: Top diameter
specFields.note: Measured on the tool drawing and re-checked on the T1 sample.

specFields.label: Base diameter
specFields.note: Drives stacking and how the glass sits on a tray.

specFields.label: Overall height
specFields.note: Rim style (straight or rolled) changes the finished height.

specFields.label: Wall thickness
specFields.note: Fixed by the cavity and core. It is not adjustable after the tool is cut.

specFields.label: Piece weight
specFields.note: Used for freight and carton calculations, so it is measured, never estimated.

specFields.label: Minimum order
specFields.note: Set by the route: an existing tool, a modified tool, or a new tool. Published route terms apply.

specFields.label: Decoration
specFields.value: Screen print, UV print, pad print, foil stamp
specFields.note: The method is confirmed against the artwork; the printable area is confirmed on the proof.

specFields.label: Packing
specFields.value: Bulk carton, polybag, printed sleeve, gift box, insert
specFields.note: Retail and marketplace rules (barcode, carton marks) are set per order.

specFields.label: Food-contact documents
specFields.value: Issued for the exact resin and color used
specFields.note: Documents follow the material actually molded, so they are requested per order.
